verdict: A Toddler Thing: Strong brand presence, needs AI-ready content structure
ai_summary: Well-positioned homepage with clear brand identity and social proof. Lacks FAQ schema, structured product answers, and detailed evidence-backed content for AI systems.

categories.name: Entity Clarity
categories.finding: Brand name, mission, and value props clear in title/meta tags
categories.fix: Add Organization schema with founder, established date, certifications

categories.name: Extractable Structure
categories.finding: BreadcrumbList present but limited semantic markup on main content
categories.fix: Wrap product categories and benefits in marked-up sections

categories.name: Schema Markup
categories.finding: Basic schemas detected; missing Product, Review, LocalBusiness schemas
categories.fix: Add Product schema with ingredients, ratings; Review schema for testimonials

categories.name: FAQ Coverage
categories.finding: No FAQ schema; common parent questions unanswered in HTML
categories.fix: Create FAQPage schema addressing rashes, materials, certifications, pricing

categories.name: Answer-Led Content
categories.finding: Benefits stated but no structured Q&A or direct answer format
categories.fix: Lead with 'Why muslin?' 'Is it organic?' structure for AI parsing

categories.name: Specificity & Evidence
categories.finding: Social proof (10,000+ parents) present; lacks certifications, lab tests, return data
categories.fix: Add GOTS certification, safety test results, parent review aggregation

top_fixes: Add FAQPage schema addressing diaper safety, material sourcing, certifications
Embed Product schema on homepage with soft-launch category descriptions
Include Review/AggregateRating schema with parent testimonial validation

gaps.why: AI systems need verifiable evidence for health claims
gaps.fix: Publish GOTS, OEKO-TEX, pediatrician endorsements visibly

gaps.why: No structured answers to common objections (rashes, fit, durability)
gaps.fix: Create Q&A section with schema covering 5-8 frequent questions

gaps.why: Vague sustainability claim; AI needs material sourcing clarity
gaps.fix: Define manufacturing process, materials, eco impact metrics

jeevanai_value: JeevanAI transforms this homepage by auto-generating FAQ schema, extracting pain-point answers, and validating sustainability claims for AI discovery.
